The '''IM-A-761 oceanic garrison''', also known as '''The Blackfathom''' was a relatively new line of Imperial garrisons specializing in [[Planet/Legends|planets]] with wide oceans created by [[Rothana Heavy Engineering/Legends|Rothana Heavy Engineering]].<ref name="IHB" />

==Characteristics==
A Blackfathom lacked the underground levels due to it being aquatic based, but it compensated for this with several powerful [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]] to keep it afloat, even during the heaviest waves. In addition, it was equipped with underwater hangar bays. The contingent included [[Aquatic assault stormtrooper|seatroopers]], repulsor-subs<ref name="IHB" /> and [[Aquatic Terrain Armored Transport|AT-AT swimmers]].<ref name="IG">{{JournalCite|12|Imperial Garrisons}}</ref> It is implied that the repulsorlifts ability to withstand heavy waves was the result of an [[incident on Shaum Hii]] that caused a [[NewsNet]] frenzy.<ref name="IHB" />
